notes: Not automated: [On Play] If your Leader has the "Fish-Man" or {East Blue} type, give up to 1 rested DON!! card to 1 of your Leader. Then, up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 5 or less cannot be rested until the end of your opponent's next turn.
